dataset.name: CLLmap pretreatment cohort (Broad, 2022)
dataset.description: Independent CLL/SLL cohort restricted to explicitly untreated, pretreatment peripheral-blood specimens with patient-linked overall and failure-free survival.
dataset.cohort_context: CLLmap includes CLL/SLL, monoclonal B-cell lymphocytosis and specimens obtained both before and after treatment. TRACE Explorer excludes MBL and post-treatment specimens, then retains the source-defined day-zero reference RNA specimen when more than one profile exists for a patient.

metadata.endpoint_context: Overall and failure-free survival measured from the sequenced reference sample
metadata.sample_selection_note: Eligibility requires CLL, Pre-treatment and Untreated source labels. Four later duplicate RNA profiles are excluded using the pinned specimen timeline: DFCI-5193, JB-0010, DFCI-5170 and DFCI-5053. Their corresponding day-zero reference profiles are CRC-0007, CRC-0009, CRC-0011 and CRC-0020.
metadata.source_join_note: The source expression matrix contains one RNA column, CRC-0035, whose sample record has no matching patient clinical row. It is not eligible and is reported by the adapter as an unmatched patient-metadata join.
metadata.histology_note: Twenty-five source MBL profiles are not CLL/SLL and are excluded before endpoint evaluation.
metadata.treatment_note: Post-treatment specimens are not pooled with the primary untreated cohort.
metadata.overlap_note: The cohort is independent of TCGA and remains a hematologic study universe in hierarchical pan-cancer analysis.

samples.sample_role: Peripheral-blood CLL RNA-seq specimen collected before treatment

expression.label: TPM transformed as log2(TPM + 1)
expression.mapping_source: Source-provided gene symbols in the pinned CLLmap/DataHub matrix
expression.duplicate_feature_rationale: All rows belonging to each of the 241 repeated case-insensitive source symbols are excluded rather than aggregated, leaving 54,994 uniquely identified complete symbols.
expression.scale_note: TRACE Explorer applies log2(TPM + 1) to source-provided TPM. Values support within-cohort comparisons and are not pooled numerically with other studies.

endpoints.label: Overall survival
endpoints.time_origin: Date of the sequenced reference sample

endpoints.label: Source-defined failure-free survival
endpoints.time_origin: Date of the sequenced reference sample
endpoints.event_definition: Treatment initiation, progression or death as encoded by CLLmap
